#### Quick Facts

#### Due Date

#### Goal

The goal of the complete draft and final edited project is to synthesize all prior work into a cohesive research paper analyzing your collected Islands data.

#### To Turn In

- As a group:
   -  In your team's shared RStudio Project folder, go back to the Quarto document you used for the draft and make any changes or additions based on feedback you received. All members contribute to **both** writing and computation.
- Individually:
   - Personal reflection as a PDF file submitted individually to Canvas.
   - Group dynamic report submitted as a PDF file individually to Canvas.
:::


## Assignment Deliverables

See [project-draft.qmd](project-draft.qmd) for details on the group submission of the complete draft of your Islands research project combining all prior components into a unified, publication-style report.

## Reflection and Group Dynamics

Each student must individually submit:

- **Personal Reflection (1–2 pages):**  
  Describe what you learned from the Islands Project.  
  Address questions such as:
  - Which parts were most enjoyable or most challenging?  
  - Which parts connected most to class material?  
  - Which skills transfer to other contexts?  
  - What statistical ideas do you want to explore further?

- **Group Dynamic Report:**  
  Reflect on collaboration quality and role distribution.  
  Discuss:
  - Whether all members contributed equally.  
  - How well task division and assigned roles worked.  
  - Any concerns or commendations regarding group performance.  
  - Anything you wish to share confidentially about teamwork.
